mapper.select: SELECT latest.consent_type AS consent_type, consent.agreed AS agreed FROM ( SELECT consent_type, MAX(customer_consent_id) AS latest_id FROM customer_consent WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND consent_type IN ( 'NOTIFY_PUSH', 'NOTIFY_SMS', 'NOTIFY_EMAIL', 'NOTIFY_SETTLEMENT', 'NOTIFY_BAND', 'NOTIFY_COMMENT', 'NOTIFY_KIRU' ) GROUP BY consent_type ) latest JOIN customer_consent consent ON consent.customer_consent_id = latest.latest_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_consent (customer_id, consent_type, agreed, changed_at) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{consentType}, #{agreed}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
